metadata.comment: The seam. A JSON array with ONE lesson object: { title, hook, landing, conceptId, steps[{id,title,goal,unlocks,sectionIds[]}], sections[{id,kind,...}] }. Every section id a step claims must exist, exactly once. When the backend lands, a query replaces this node and the outputs stay the same.
